verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. RuleVars::VarIris now recursively converts variables inside quoted formula terms, and the public-path regression test exercises the real parser/serializer path while pinning the no-syntactic-variable rule invariant. Premise blank-node provenance now uses an internal name containing '.', which the source variable lexer cannot accept; the regression test confirms legal lookalike variables remain variables, conclusion-only occurrences retain their meaning, and an attempted forged internal name fails parsing. This is improving versus round 1: both major findings are fixed with non-vacuous integration coverage, and no new correctness, soundness, or security issue is evident in the diff-scoped review.
